sections.section_title: GPIO port output speed register (GPIOx_OSPEEDR) (x = A, B, C, D, F)
sections.text_helper: Section 8.5.3 "GPIO port output speed register (GPIOx_OSPEEDR) (x = A, B, C, D, F)" in chapter 8 (General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 189.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x08
Reset value: 0x0C00 0000 (for port A)
Reset value: 0x0000 0000 (ports other than A)
Bits 31:0 OSPEEDy[1:0]: Port x configuration for I/O y (y = 15 to 0)
These bits are written by software to configure the I/O output speed.
00: Very low speed
01: Low speed
10: High speed
11: Very high speed
Note: Refer to the device datasheet for the frequency specifications and the power supply
and load conditions for each speed..
The FT_c GPIOs cannot be set to high speed.
